general.title: General skincare guidance
general.note: Unsourced in the seed; needs expert review.

skin_types.name: Normal
skin_types.description: Balanced; neither often oily nor often tight.
skin_types.identify: Comfortable after cleansing, little shine, few visible pores.

skin_types.name: Dry
skin_types.identify: Tight, rough or flaky, especially after washing; little shine.

skin_types.name: Oily
skin_types.identify: Shiny across the face a few hours after washing; enlarged pores.

skin_types.name: Combination
skin_types.description: Oily in the T-zone (forehead, nose, chin), normal or dry elsewhere.
skin_types.identify: Shine on forehead and nose, comfortable or tight cheeks.

flags.name: Often irritated or using strong actives

caution_rules.reason: Strong exfoliating acids can irritate sensitive skin.
Pause exfoliating acids while skin is irritated or over-exfoliated.
Dry skin can be easily over-exfoliated.
Retinoids are not recommended in pregnancy, and can worsen an irritated or damaged barrier.
Use no strong actives until the barrier recovers.
Sulfate cleansers can leave skin tight.
Prefer non-foaming cleansers when skin feels tight.
Fragrance, dyes, alcohol and scrubs often irritate sensitive skin.
Avoid irritants while the barrier recovers.

concerns.name: Hyperpigmentation (dark marks)
concerns.summary: Areas of skin that look darker than the surrounding skin.
concerns.recognise: Flat dark spots or patches, often on cheeks, forehead or where pimples were.

concerns.name: Dehydration
concerns.summary: Skin lacking water (not oil). Can affect any skin type, including oily.
concerns.recognise: Dullness, fine surface lines, tightness or itchiness, a tired look, patchy makeup.

concern_ingredients.reason: Niacinamide helps fade dark marks and suits most skin types.
Gentle vitamin C helps brighten uneven tone.
Azelaic acid helps with marks left by breakouts.
Alpha arbutin helps lighten dark spots.
Tranexamic acid can help patchy pigmentation.
Sunscreen stops marks from darkening.
Sunscreen stops marks from darkening.
Scrubs can irritate skin and worsen marks.
Glycerin draws water into the skin.
Hyaluronic acid holds water in the skin; seal it in with a moisturiser.
Ceramides strengthen the skin barrier so water stays in.
Panthenol hydrates and calms.
Aloe hydrates and soothes.
Squalane seals in moisture without heaviness.
Shea butter seals in water for dry skin.
Lactic acid gives gentle surface hydration.
Fragrance can irritate dry or dehydrated skin.
Dyes can irritate dry or dehydrated skin.
Alcohol can dry out and irritate skin.
Physical scrubs can irritate dry or dehydrated skin.
Undiluted essential oils can irritate skin.

advice_tips.text: Switch to a gentle, non-foaming, sulfate-free cleanser.
For a short while, cleanse with lukewarm water only until your skin feels comfortable.
Pause scrubs, exfoliating acids and retinoids until your skin feels comfortable again.
Keep showers short and warm, use a humidifier if you can, and moisturise while skin is still damp.
Cleanse no more than twice a day.
Drink enough water and eat water-rich foods such as watermelon, strawberries, cucumber and celery.
Do not skip moisturiser; choose lightweight gel textures.
Try a creamy or gel cleanser instead of a foaming one.
Wear sunscreen every morning; sun exposure darkens marks.
Avoid picking or squeezing breakouts; it can leave marks.
Fading marks takes several weeks to months; give a routine time.

test_cases.name: A: combination skin, severe dehydration after over-exfoliating
test_cases.why: Lactic-acid serum, retinol, foaming SLS cleanser, fragrance/alcohol products and the dry-skin cream are all filtered out; avoid beats seek.

test_cases.name: B: dry sensitive skin, moderate hyperpigmentation, pregnancy unsure
test_cases.why: Azelaic treatment is excluded by skin type, retinol by the pregnancy default, fragrance cream by sensitivity.

test_cases.name: C: red flag stops recommendations
test_cases.why: Any red flag means refer to a professional and show no products.

test_cases.name: D: too few real answers
test_cases.why: Fewer than 3 real answers: ask the user to retake or choose manually.

test_cases.name: E: oily skin, mild dehydration, no cautions (lactic acid serum allowed)
test_cases.why: Same lactic-acid serum that case A excludes is allowed here, because no flag or sensitivity blocks it.
